correctness.rationale: The physicality eigenvalues and the partial-transpose eigenvalues are explicitly nonnegative under the stated parameter domain; 2x2 PPT implies separability. With Alice marginal I/2, arbitrary Alice effects realize the unit Bloch ball and the exact POVM supremum is the operator norm of the projected correlation matrix. Direct amplitude-damping Bloch transformation gives two orthogonal projected rows, yielding the displayed singular-value maximum for every 0<=gamma<=1. Subtracting kappa squared reduces strict enhancement to positivity of a concave quadratic on (0,1); its discriminant factorization and endpoint signs prove the single exact reentrant interval. Exact Fraction checks and direct Kraus/projector coherence tests for 32 cases independently corroborate the algebra. Limits: no assertion outside the stated parameter family.

value.rationale: The source explicitly motivates the statewise question by showing numerical coherence growth for prolate steering ellipsoids. This result gives a sharp and necessary-and-sufficient geometric threshold across a natural full three-parameter separable family, not a single selected numerical input, and proves exactly one reentrant amplitude-damping enhancement window with algebraic endpoints. The explicit PPT construction isolates coherence enhancement from entanglement and supplies concrete testable predictions for a standard qubit noise channel; these are nontrivial structural consequences beyond routine parameter substitution.
